title: zetta.ml.GoldenOracle
description: Committed golden numeric expectations for the native churn featurize -> train -> TreeSHAP pipeline: the RSK-8 native correctness oracle (#395). Generated once, offline, by zetta's own native engine (no Python/XGBoost/foreign runtime) and checked in as static data; tests/test_native_oracle.cpp asserts native outputs against these values within tolerance. The committed numbers are pinned regression anchors whose correctness is independently established by the analytic closed-form micro-tests, the SHAP efficiency invariant (base_value + sum(values) == predicted), and the single-node == multi-node == different-shard-count equivalence layer.

featurize.description: The expected leakage-free feature table (one row per account in the entity universe, ascending key order).

features.description: features[column][row], aligned to feature_names then entities.

train.description: The expected trained GBDT outputs over the feature table under the canonical hyperparameters.

probabilities.description: Predicted churn probability per entity, in featurize entity order.

shap.description: The expected exact TreeSHAP attributions over the trained model (raw / margin space).

mean_abs_shap.description: Global mean |phi| per feature over every entity (the population driver importances).

values.description: phi per feature, in feature_names order. Efficiency: base_value + sum(values) == predicted.
